verdict.rationale: EFTPS documents its own Batch Provider Software and lets tax professionals make payments for multiple clients under a single login. That is a first-party batch channel for acting across many items. Beyond the product's name and one line of copy, nothing describes what the batch tool actually does, and the probes found no API for programmatic bulk actions. Missing for 10: documented bulk submission/change/cancel semantics, batch file format or limits, programmatic/API access for agents, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: If you're a tax professional, you can make payments for multiple clients under a single login.
